# Omni and audio-visual language models

<!-- Generated by scripts/catalog.py from data/models.json. Edit the JSON, then regenerate. -->

[← Model index](../README.md#models)

**Reviewed as of 2026-09-12 · 131 entries.**

Models combining language, audio/speech and vision, plus explicitly identified multimodal systems. Understanding-only models are included: the word omni does not guarantee audio output or any-to-any generation.

**Modalities:** T = text, I = image, V = video, A = general audio, S = speech, M = music, X = other structured modalities. A is a broad label, not a guarantee of every audio task. See the [methodology](../docs/methodology.md) for interaction labels, variant scope and inclusion rules.

Dates below refer to the linked paper or announcement, **not necessarily a weights/API release**. An em dash means no date was established from the reviewed source.

## Model notes

<a id="agav-rater"></a>

### AGAV-Rater

Rates generated audiovisual content, audio and music.

<a id="amazon-nova-2-omni"></a>

### Amazon Nova 2 Omni

Announced as a preview; accepts speech but the announcement specifies text and image outputs.

**Listed variants:** Nova 2 Omni Preview.

<a id="anygpt"></a>

### AnyGPT

Autoregressive modeling of text, images, speech and music.

**Listed variants:** Base; Chat.

<a id="anymal"></a>

### AnyMAL

Any-modality conditioning of a text LLM, including motion-sensor signals.

<a id="arc-hunyuan-video"></a>

### ARC-Hunyuan-Video

Structured descriptions, timestamps and questions about short videos.

**Listed variants:** 7B.

<a id="audio-visual-llm"></a>

### Audio-Visual LLM

Handles visual-only, audio-only and audiovisual video instructions.

<a id="aurora"></a>

### AURORA

Reference audio-visual segmentation with staged alignment and reinforcement learning.

<a id="av-reasoner"></a>

### AV-Reasoner

Specialized fine-tuned model for clue-grounded audiovisual counting.

<a id="avicuna"></a>

### AVicuna

Uses pseudo-untrimmed videos for temporal localization and dialogue.

<a id="baichuan-omni"></a>

### Baichuan-Omni

The initial release documents multimodal understanding; speech generation arrives in 1.5.

**Listed variants:** 7B.

<a id="baichuan-omni-1-5"></a>

### Baichuan-Omni-1.5

Adds an integrated speech-generation path to the Baichuan omni family.

<a id="bubogpt"></a>

### BuboGPT

Connects audio-visual answers to image regions through an external grounding module.

<a id="capybara-omni"></a>

### Capybara-OMNI

Efficient training recipe with understanding and chat releases.

**Listed variants:** Understanding; Chat.

<a id="cat"></a>

### CAT

Question-conditioned audio-visual features support dynamic scene reasoning.

<a id="chatbridge"></a>

### ChatBridge

Learns cross-modal connections using language-paired training data.

<a id="chronusomni"></a>

### ChronusOmni

Uses timestamps and reinforcement learning for audio-visual temporal grounding.

<a id="codi-2"></a>

### CoDi-2

Supports interleaved multimodal conditioning and interactive any-to-any generation.

<a id="crab"></a>

### Crab

Unifies scene reasoning with temporal, spatial and pixel-level localization tasks.

<a id="crema"></a>

### CREMA

Extends video reasoning with audio and additional sensor-derived representations.

<a id="deepsound-v1"></a>

### DeepSound-V1

Uses language-model reasoning to align generated sounds with videos.

<a id="duplexomni"></a>

### DuplexOmni

Processes streaming audiovisual input while producing spoken responses; reasoning is a pluggable layer.

<a id="echoink-r1"></a>

### EchoInk-R1

Named fine-tuned model for audio-image reasoning; does not establish a new base architecture.

**Listed variants:** 7B.

<a id="egogpt"></a>

### EgoGPT

The model introduced alongside the EgoLife dataset and assistant project.

<a id="ellsa"></a>

### ELLSA

Joint listening, visual perception, speech and action generation in a single interaction model.

<a id="emotion-llama"></a>

### Emotion-LLaMA

Multimodal emotion recognition and explanations.

<a id="emova"></a>

### EMOVA

Combines image understanding with expressive speech interaction.

<a id="empatheia"></a>

### Empatheia

The system introduced with AvaMERG; the benchmark itself is not a model.

<a id="empathyear"></a>

### EmpathyEar

Generates text, synchronized speech and talking-face responses.

<a id="ep-alm"></a>

### eP-ALM

Research configurations adapt frozen language models to image, video and audio tasks.

<a id="favor"></a>

### FAVOR

Fine-grained fusion of visual frames, speech and other audio events.

<a id="gemini-1-0"></a>

### Gemini 1.0

Initial Gemini report covers a family; its research modality claims do not establish identical public endpoints for every size.

**Listed variants:** Ultra; Pro.

<a id="gemini-1-5"></a>

### Gemini 1.5

Audio and video understanding with text responses.

**Listed variants:** Pro; Flash; Flash-8B.

<a id="gemini-2-0"></a>

### Gemini 2.0

Standard understanding endpoints are listed here; experimental native-audio interfaces have different output capabilities.

**Listed variants:** Flash; Flash-Lite.

<a id="gemini-2-5"></a>

### Gemini 2.5

The general Pro/Flash models produce text; native-audio Live and TTS variants have their own entries.

**Listed variants:** Pro; Flash; Flash-Lite.

<a id="gemini-2-5-flash-live"></a>

### Gemini 2.5 Flash Live

Realtime audiovisual input with native speech output; live transcription is an associated API feature.

**Listed variants:** gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025.

<a id="gemini-3"></a>

### Gemini 3

Pro and Flash preview understanding models; audio input does not imply speech generation.

**Listed variants:** 3 Pro Preview; 3 Flash Preview.

<a id="gemini-3-1"></a>

### Gemini 3.1

General understanding variants are separate from Flash Live and Flash TTS.

**Listed variants:** 3.1 Pro Preview; 3.1 Flash-Lite.

<a id="gemini-3-1-flash-live"></a>

### Gemini 3.1 Flash Live

Documents both text and audio responses to multimodal inputs.

**Listed variants:** gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview.

<a id="gemini-3-5"></a>

### Gemini 3.5

General audio/vision understanding; specialized translation and transcription models are listed separately.

**Listed variants:** 3.5 Flash; 3.5 Flash-Lite.

<a id="gemini-3-6-flash"></a>

### Gemini 3.6 Flash

Supports audio input and text output; its model page does not support audio generation.

**Listed variants:** gemini-3.6-flash.

<a id="gemini-3-7-flash"></a>

### Gemini 3.7 Flash

Text-generating model with audio, image and video understanding.

**Listed variants:** gemini-3.7-flash.

<a id="gemini-3-8-flash"></a>

### Gemini 3.8 Flash

The September 2026 model documentation lists audio input but no audio generation.

**Listed variants:** gemini-3.8-flash.

<a id="gemma-3n"></a>

### Gemma 3n

On-device multimodal understanding; the listed model generates text.

**Listed variants:** E2B; E4B.

<a id="gemma-4-audio-capable-variants"></a>

### Gemma 4 (audio-capable variants)

Audio coverage here applies to E2B, E4B and 12B Unified; larger visual-only variants are not assigned speech capabilities.

**Listed variants:** E2B; E4B; 12B Unified.

<a id="gpt-4o-reported-model"></a>

### GPT-4o (reported model)

System-card capabilities describe the reported model. Individual text, audio and realtime APIs expose different subsets.

**Listed variants:** GPT-4o research/system-card scope.

<a id="gpt-realtime"></a>

### GPT-Realtime

Realtime API model with image input; image support does not imply a native video stream.

**Listed variants:** gpt-realtime.

<a id="gpt-realtime-mini"></a>

### GPT-Realtime Mini

Smaller realtime API variant with image input.

**Listed variants:** gpt-realtime-mini.

<a id="gpt-realtime-1-5"></a>

### GPT-Realtime-1.5

Audio-focused interaction with text and image conditioning.

**Listed variants:** gpt-realtime-1.5.

<a id="gpt-realtime-2"></a>

### GPT-Realtime-2

API model combining speech interaction, reasoning and tool use.

**Listed variants:** gpt-realtime-2.

<a id="gpt-realtime-2-1"></a>

### GPT-Realtime-2.1

Successor voice model with text, image and audio input.

**Listed variants:** gpt-realtime-2.1.

<a id="gpt-realtime-2-1-mini"></a>

### GPT-Realtime-2.1 Mini

Compact API variant of the realtime reasoning family.

**Listed variants:** gpt-realtime-2.1-mini.

<a id="groundinggpt"></a>

### GroundingGPT

Returns language and localization information for visual and audio inputs.

<a id="humanomni"></a>

### HumanOmni

Specializes in people, interactions and human-centered video interpretation.

<a id="humanomniv2"></a>

### HumanOmniV2

Extends the HumanOmni line with multimodal reasoning training.

<a id="imagebind-llm"></a>

### ImageBind-LLM

Uses ImageBind alignment to extend a language model to additional input modalities.

<a id="interactiveomni"></a>

### InteractiveOmni

Multi-turn audiovisual dialogue with a trained speech-generation component.

**Listed variants:** 4B; 8B.

<a id="internomni"></a>

### InternOmni

Audio-enabled extension of InternVL; consult its release-specific checkpoint instructions.

<a id="longcat-flash-omni"></a>

### LongCat-Flash-Omni

Real-time audiovisual interaction built on the LongCat-Flash backbone.

<a id="longcat-next"></a>

### LongCat-Next

Models multiple modalities through token sequences; check the report for individual generation paths.

<a id="lyra"></a>

### Lyra

Speech-centered multimodal understanding and spoken interaction.

<a id="m2-omni"></a>

### M2-omni

Interleaves text, image and audio outputs; release claims require checking the linked report.

<a id="macaw-llm"></a>

### Macaw-LLM

Instruction-following over image, video and audio inputs.

<a id="meerkat"></a>

### Meerkat

Audio-visual grounding in space and time.

<a id="megrez-omni"></a>

### Megrez-Omni

Megrez-3B-Omni is the multimodal member; Megrez-3B-Instruct is text-only.

**Listed variants:** Megrez-3B-Omni.

<a id="mimo-v2-omni"></a>

### MiMo-V2-Omni

Omni perception with structured tool calls and UI grounding.

<a id="mimo-v2-5"></a>

### MiMo-V2.5

Native multimodal understanding on the MiMo-V2-Flash backbone.

**Listed variants:** Base; Instruct.

<a id="ming-flash-omni"></a>

### Ming-Flash-Omni

Extends the Ming family with image tasks and joint acoustic generation.

**Listed variants:** Preview.

<a id="ming-flash-omni-2-0"></a>

### Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0

Supports speech, sound and music synthesis alongside image generation and editing.

**Listed variants:** 2.0.

<a id="ming-omni"></a>

### Ming-Omni

A family supporting perception, speech output and image generation.

**Listed variants:** Ming-Omni; Ming-lite-omni Preview; v1; v1.5.

<a id="mini-omni2"></a>

### Mini-Omni2

Adds visual input and interruption-aware duplex interaction to Mini-Omni.

<a id="minicpm-o-2-6"></a>

### MiniCPM-o 2.6

The 2.6 omni release supports speech and audiovisual interaction.

**Listed variants:** 2.6.

<a id="minicpm-o-4-5"></a>

### MiniCPM-o 4.5

Adds simultaneous seeing, listening and speaking with proactive behavior.

**Listed variants:** 4.5.

<a id="minimind-o"></a>

### MiniMind-O

Small speech-native model with frozen speech and vision encoders.

<a id="mio"></a>

### MIO

Models understanding and generation using discrete multimodal sequences.

<a id="mllm-tool"></a>

### MLLM-Tool

Selects external tools from visual, auditory and textual instructions.

<a id="modaverse"></a>

### ModaVerse

The language model controls separate modality generators through natural-language instructions.

<a id="modelcompose"></a>

### ModelCompose

Combines existing multimodal language models through parameter composition.

**Listed variants:** NaiveMC; DAMC.

<a id="moshivis"></a>

### MoshiVis

Adds image-conditioned conversation to the Moshi speech model.

<a id="multiply"></a>

### MultiPLY

Includes touch, temperature and interaction with objects in a 3D environment.

<a id="mumu-llama"></a>

### MuMu-LLaMA

Uses AudioLDM 2 and MusicGen for music generation and editing.

<a id="next-gpt"></a>

### NExT-GPT

Any-to-any system with pretrained modality-specific generators.

<a id="next-omni"></a>

### NExT-OMNI

Unified understanding and generation with a non-autoregressive multimodal token model.

<a id="nexus"></a>

### Nexus

Audio alignment builds on an existing vision-language model; also called Nexus-O.

**Listed variants:** Nexus-O.

<a id="oisa"></a>

### OISA

The model accompanying OmniAVS; generates reasoning and fine-grained segmentation outputs.

<a id="ola"></a>

### Ola

Uses video as a bridge for joint image, video and audio understanding.

<a id="omcat"></a>

### OMCAT

Learns temporal relationships between events in audio and video.

<a id="omni-autothink"></a>

### Omni-AutoThink

Adjusts reasoning behavior across text, audio and visual tasks.

<a id="omni-r1-two-system-collaboration"></a>

### Omni-R1 (two-system collaboration)

Zhong et al.; couples keyframe selection with pixel-level understanding.

<a id="omni-rewardmodel"></a>

### Omni-RewardModel

Scores or explains preferences across modalities; this is an evaluator, not a spoken assistant.

**Listed variants:** Discriminative; Generative.

<a id="omniatlas"></a>

### OmniAtlas

The trained agent accompanying OmniGAIA; OmniGAIA itself is a benchmark.

<a id="omnivideo-r1"></a>

### OmniVideo-R1

A reasoning-trained audiovisual model, rather than a new base-model family.

<a id="omnivinci"></a>

### OmniVinci

The primary report centers on multimodal understanding; no speech output is asserted here.

<a id="onellm"></a>

### OneLLM

Aligns eight modalities with a language model, including point clouds and sensor signals.

<a id="openomni"></a>

### OpenOmni

Supports emotional speech output; unrelated to the Omni-Emotion paper.

<a id="pandagpt"></a>

### PandaGPT

Uses shared multimodal representations for instruction-following.

**Listed variants:** 7B; 13B.

<a id="pathweave"></a>

### PathWeave

Adds modalities incrementally instead of retraining all modalities jointly.

<a id="phi-4-multimodal"></a>

### Phi-4-multimodal

The multimodal release accepts audio and vision; Phi-4-mini is a separate text model.

**Listed variants:** Phi-4-multimodal-instruct.

<a id="qwen2-5-omni"></a>

### Qwen2.5-Omni

Processes audiovisual inputs and produces streaming speech with text.

**Listed variants:** 3B; 7B.

<a id="qwen3-omni"></a>

### Qwen3-Omni

Speech output depends on variant; the Captioner is an audio-to-text specialization.

**Listed variants:** 30B-A3B-Instruct; 30B-A3B-Thinking; 30B-A3B-Captioner.

<a id="qwen3-5-omni"></a>

### Qwen3.5-Omni

Report describes the Plus model; a technical report does not establish open-weight availability.

**Listed variants:** Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus.

<a id="r1-omni"></a>

### R1-Omni

HumanOmni-based emotion reasoning; distinct from the papers named Omni-R1.

<a id="ref-thinker-tgs-agent"></a>

### Ref-Thinker / TGS-Agent

Ref-Thinker reasons over the reference; Grounding-DINO and SAM2 localize and segment it.

**Listed variants:** Ref-Thinker; TGS-Agent system.

<a id="roboego"></a>

### RoboEgo

System-card description of a native duplex model, also called FLM-Ego.

**Listed variants:** FLM-Ego.

<a id="roboomni"></a>

### RoboOmni

Robot system combines multimodal intent recognition, spoken confirmation and actions.

<a id="savenvideo"></a>

### SAVEnVideo

The video model introduced with SAVEn-Vid; the dataset is not counted separately.

<a id="seed2-0-lite-audio-update"></a>

### Seed2.0 Lite (audio update)

The late-April update adds audio to Lite; the same claim is not applied to every Seed2.0 size.

**Listed variants:** Seed2.0 Lite audio-capable update.

<a id="seedrealtime"></a>

### SeedRealtime

Continuously combines watching, listening and spoken responses with proactive timing.

<a id="shizhengpt"></a>

### ShizhenGPT

Traditional Chinese medicine research model with images, audio and physiological signals.

<a id="solami"></a>

### SOLAMI

Generates speech and motion for embodied social interaction.

<a id="spider"></a>

### Spider

Coordinates multiple output modalities within a single response.

<a id="st-omni-r1"></a>

### ST-Omni-R1

Uses panoramic video and spatial audio for sound-source reasoning and localization.

<a id="stream-omni"></a>

### Stream-Omni

Supports simultaneous multimodal interactions with text, vision and speech.

<a id="tdc-video"></a>

### TDC-Video

Combines audio-visual tokens with compact temporal context for long videos.

<a id="teal"></a>

### TEAL

Treats multiple input and output modalities as token sequences.

<a id="trisense"></a>

### TriSense

Jointly models visual, sound and speech cues for temporal video understanding.

<a id="uni-moe"></a>

### Uni-MoE

Routes multimodal representations through specialized experts.

<a id="uni-moe-2-0-omni"></a>

### Uni-MoE 2.0 Omni

Adds image and speech generation to the Lychee/Uni-MoE line.

<a id="unified-io-2"></a>

### Unified-IO 2

Supports text, images, audio, localization and actions in one autoregressive framework.

<a id="unifiedmllm"></a>

### UnifiedMLLM

Uses a language model to coordinate multimodal tasks and task-specific output modules.

<a id="video-llama"></a>

### Video-LLaMA

The original audiovisual release; audio/video support varies across successor families.

<a id="video-salmonn"></a>

### video-SALMONN

Combines speech, audio events and visual frames for video understanding.

<a id="video-salmonn-2"></a>

### video-SALMONN 2

Caption-enhanced family with audiovisual question answering.

**Listed variants:** 2; 2F; 2+ (3B/7B/72B).

<a id="video-salmonn-o1"></a>

### video-SALMONN-o1

Adds explicit reasoning to audiovisual understanding.

<a id="videollama-2"></a>

### VideoLLaMA 2

Use the audiovisual checkpoints when audio input is required.

<a id="videopoet"></a>

### VideoPoet

Autoregressively generates video and matching audio from multimodal conditioning.

<a id="vita"></a>

### VITA

The original system uses a separate speech synthesis component; model output is listed as text.

<a id="vita-1-5"></a>

### VITA-1.5

Extends the VITA line toward real-time speech generation.

<a id="worldgpt"></a>

Predicts multimodal state transitions with memory and retrieval components.

<a id="x-instructblip"></a>

### X-InstructBLIP

Aligns image, video, audio and 3D encoders to a frozen language model.

Connects frozen encoders with ChatGLM for multimodal instruction-following.

<a id="x-vila"></a>

Cross-modality alignment with a visual information pathway.
